result.title: A Generalized Sparse Fuzzy Clustering Framework with Automated Cluster Cardinality Estimation Ability
result.comment: 25 pages, highlights, 14 figures, under review in Elsevier journal
result.summary: Fuzzy clustering provides a robust framework for handling ambiguous and overlapping data boundaries, yet its traditional formulation generates entirely dense membership assignments that limit noise resilience and prevent estimating the true number of clusters, when it is unknown. To address these limitations, we introduce in this paper the Generalized Sparse Fuzzy Clustering (GSFC) framework, which incorporates a continuous sparsity penalty into the fuzzy objective function. Because closed-form solutions are precluded by the simultaneous presence of fuzzifier and sparsity exponents, we propose an efficient primal-dual bisection search coupled with specialized analytic pathways to rigorously enforce the partition constraint while organically driving trace memberships to exact zero. This mathematically enforced sparsity empowers the algorithm to autonomously estimate the true number of clusters by dynamically pruning redundant clusters, provided that it is initialized by a larger than the true number of clusters. Furthermore, we integrate a virtual noise sink to insulate outliers from the rest of the data points. The usage of the proposed framework is also extended to line segment detection. Extensive empirical evaluations across synthetic toy datasets, high-noise geometric stress tests, and real-world benchmarks (UCI wine dataset and hyperspectral images) demonstrate that GSFC effectively exceeds conventional fuzzy benchmarks while autonomously resolving cluster cardinality. Additionally, it significantly outperforms existing sparse possibilistic and probabilistic soft-clustering alternatives in line detection tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出广义稀疏模糊聚类（GSFC）框架，在模糊目标函数中加入连续稀疏惩罚，用原对偶二分搜索求解，从而在初始化簇数偏多时自动剪枝冗余簇并估计真实簇数，同时引入虚拟噪声汇吸收离群点，并扩展到线段检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于经典模糊聚类与稀疏优化方法，未涉及视觉或多模态推理的内部状态、证据筛选、状态更新或停止决策；稀疏剪枝只作用于聚类隶属度而非推理过程，缺乏可供核查的 LVR 借鉴线索，故排除。
